speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh
text: asked	the Minister for National Development (a) in the last 10 years, what is the percentage change in the number of HDB flats, private flats and landed properties in relation to the total number of dwelling units in Singapore; and (b) what is the projected proportion of HDB flats to non-HDB flats for 2020.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: This is between the period of 2006 and 2016.

speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
text: Would the Minister consider keeping this ratio for the long term?

speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
text: I understand it used to be 80:20; now, it seems to be 70%-72%.

speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
text: So, is there a threshold that the Government would consider to maintain for this ratio, this proportion?

speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
text: As I have mentioned, over the next few years, we think that this will remain stable.

speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
text: In the longer term, how will this vary?
